full_translation_en:
Federal Parliament
House of Representatives, 2079
Sixth Session
Meeting Number - 48
Federal
Daily Business Schedule
Friday, Bhadra 6, 2082
1:00 PM
Ministry-wise Question and Answer
The concerned ministers will answer oral questions related to the Ministry of Home Affairs, Ministry of Labour, Employment and Social Security, Ministry of Youth and Sports, and Ministry of Forest and Environment.
Presentation of Committee Report
Honorable Chairperson Kusum Devi Thapa of the Agriculture, Cooperatives and Natural Resources Committee will present the "Report of the Committee on the Bill to Amend Some Nepal Laws Related to Land, 2082".
Honorable Chairperson Ammar Bahadur Thapa of the Education, Health and Information Technology Committee will present the "Report on the School Education Bill, 2080".
Management Work
Honorable Minister of Agriculture and Livestock Development, Ramnath Adhikari, will present a proposal to "Consider the Nepal Veterinary Council (First Amendment) Bill, 2082".
Honorable Minister of Science and Information Technology, Prithvi Subba Gurung, will present a proposal to "Send the Information Technology and Cyber Security Bill, 2082 to the concerned committee for clause-wise discussion".
Honorable Minister of Youth and Sports, Tejulal Chaudhary, will present a proposal to "Send the National Sports Development (First Amendment) Bill, 2082 to the concerned committee for clause-wise discussion".
Honorable Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of Finance, Bishnu Prasad Paudel:-
(a) Will present a proposal to "Discuss the Alternative Development Finance Mobilization Bill, 2082, along with the report of the Finance Committee".
(b) Will present a proposal to "Pass the Alternative Development Finance Mobilization Bill, 2082".
Padma Prasad Pandey
Secretary-General
